FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF PHARMACEUTICAL SCIENCES, SECTOR 14,
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH 160014
Advertisement for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Applications are invited along with the complete bio-data and attested copies of certificates showing
qualifications and experience for one post of JRF in the research project entitled “Sense Alzheimer Novel
Fluorescence based DNA-RNA Hybrid Photosensor for rapid detection of early stage Alzheimer’s
Disease” by DST CSRI, Government of India (DST/CSRI/2021/7) granted to Drs. Gurpal Singh and Ravi
Pratap Barnwal. Intial appointment is for one year, extended up to 3 years based on the performance.
Candidates possessing the below mentioned Educational Qualification and having a maximum of 32 year
of age for JRF as on the date of the interview (relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC
candidate) may submit their application to the undersigned along with detailed resume by 23.04.2023
either by post or email at gurpalsingh.ips@gmail.com
Eligibility: M.Pharm in Pharmaceutics/Pharmaceutical Biotechnology subjects with minimum 55% marks.
“Candidates with GPAT national entrance test conducted by Government of India will be preferred.”
Emoluments: Rs. 31,000/-p.m.+ 18% HRA for three years as per DST or Panjab University guidelines.
Yours sincerely
Sd/-
Gurpal Singh, Ph.D.
UIPS, Panjab University, Chandigarh
Note: No TA/DA will be provided. The post is purely temporary and commensurate with project.
Candidates should mention their email address and phone number in the bio data.
